# BR-500 pH and DO Control: Control Narrative (Draft Rev A)

**Scope:** equipment modules EM-BR500-PH and EM-BR500-DO.

**Basis:**
- BR-500 is a batch process, so states and phases follow ISA-88. ISA-106 covers continuous processes only. The state table uses the ISA-106 layout (permissive, initiator, automation level).
- No instrument index, cause-and-effect chart or alarm database was given. This document therefore lists the tags, interlocks and alarms the modules need.
- Values marked "confirm" are my proposals, not given data.
- Test key: **S** = simulate or force in DeltaV. **F** = field or water-run test. **R** = record or configuration review. **D** = demonstration with user roles.

---

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

EM-BR500-PH holds culture pH at the setpoint. It adds acid by CO2 sparge and base by pump. It also limits the total base added per batch.

EM-BR500-DO holds dissolved oxygen at the setpoint. It uses a cascade of agitation, air sparge and O2 sparge.

| Interface | Direction | Content |
|---|---|---|
| Batch manager (ISA-88) | In | Phase, Hold, Restart, Stop, Abort |
| Batch manager | Out | Module state, in-band status (FR-BR500-013) |
| CO2, air, O2 supply | In | Gas to FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 |
| Base bag | In | 1 M sodium carbonate to P-520, weighed by WT-521 |

Out of scope: temperature, feed, antifoam, off-gas, level, harvest. No SIS function is specified here (see OI-12).

---

## 3. States and transitions

Both modules use the same states. Control is active in the Equilibrate, Inoculate and Production phases only.

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| INACTIVE | No control. Entered in Media Fill, Harvest and after Stop or Abort. |
| AUTO | Closed-loop control. |
| MANUAL | Operator sets the outputs. Interlocks stay active. |
| HELD | Batch Hold or restart after power loss. |
| PV FAULT | Both probes of this module are bad. |

| ID | Transition | Trigger and permissive | Initiator | Automation level | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-001 | INACTIVE to AUTO | Phase Equilibrate running and SQ-01 complete | Batch | Operator-prompted, then automatic | S |
| FR-BR500-002 | AUTO to MANUAL | Operator selects MAN | Operator | Manual | S, D |
| FR-BR500-003 | MANUAL to AUTO | Operator selects AUTO and at least one probe healthy. Outputs start per FR-PH-012 and FR-DO-011. | Operator | Manual | S |
| FR-BR500-004 | AUTO or MANUAL to HELD | Batch Hold, or controller restart after power loss | Batch or system | Automatic | S, F |
| FR-BR500-005 | HELD to AUTO | Batch Restart and operator RESUME and at least one probe healthy. If SIC-530 is stopped, RESUME starts it at SP-DO-02 and waits for feedback within SP-GEN-06. Timeout SP-GEN-07. On failure the module stays HELD and raises AL-DO-07. | Batch and operator | Operator-prompted | S, F |
| FR-BR500-006 | AUTO or MANUAL to PV FAULT | Both probes of this module bad | System | Automatic | S |
| FR-BR500-007 | PV FAULT to AUTO | Operator ACK and at least one probe healthy for SP-GEN-04 | Operator | Operator-prompted | S |
| FR-BR500-008 | Any state to INACTIVE | Phase Harvest, Production complete, or batch Stop or Abort | Batch | Automatic | S |

**Outputs by state**

| ID | State | FCV-510, P-520 | SIC-530, FCV-511, FCV-512 | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-010 | INACTIVE | Closed, stopped | FCV-511 and FCV-512 closed. SIC-530 released (FR-BR500-012). | S |
| | AUTO | Per AIC-501 | Per AIC-502 | |
| | MANUAL | Operator, within limits | Operator demand, within limits | |
| | HELD | Closed, stopped | Hold last values. FCV-512 does not increase. | |
| | PV FAULT | Closed, stopped | Hold last values. FCV-512 does not increase. | |

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-011 | In INACTIVE, the modules must reject all commands to FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 and P-520. Test in Media Fill and Harvest. | S |
| FR-BR500-012 | On entry to INACTIVE, the DO module must release SIC-530 to the owning phase. SIC-530 must hold its last speed until that phase commands it (OI-08). | S |
| FR-BR500-013 | Each module must publish an in-band status. pH is in band when the absolute difference between PV-PH and SP-PH-01 is at most SP-PH-02. DO is in band when the difference between PV-DO and SP-DO-01 is at most SP-DO-18. | S |
| FR-BR500-014 | A bad probe or WT-521 must rejoin only after good quality and in-range for SP-GEN-04. | S |
| FR-BR500-009 | If a module stays in MANUAL longer than SP-GEN-05, it must raise AL-BR500-03. It must not change state. | S |

---

## 4. Regulatory control

No tuning values are given here. Tuning is set at commissioning.

| Loop | PV | Output | Action | Mode behavior | Override |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AIC-501 acid path | PV-PH | FCV-510 | Direct: more CO2 as pH rises | AUTO, MANUAL, off in other states | Interlocks in section 6 |
| AIC-501 base path | PV-PH | P-520 pulse | Reverse: more base as pH falls | Same | Base total lockout |
| AIC-502 | PV-DO | Demand (0 to 100 %) split over SIC-530, FCV-511, FCV-512 | Reverse: more demand as DO falls | Same | FR-DO-020 |

### 4.1 pH (EM-BR500-PH)

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-PH-001 | When both probes are healthy, PV-PH must equal the average of AT-501A and AT-501B. | S |
| FR-PH-002 | A probe is bad when its quality is bad or its value is outside SP-PH-03 to SP-PH-04. The module must exclude a bad probe and raise AL-PH-03. | S |
| FR-PH-003 | When one probe is bad, PV-PH must equal the healthy probe. | S |
| FR-PH-004 | When both probes are healthy and differ by more than SP-PH-05 for SP-PH-06, the module must raise AL-PH-05. Control must continue on the average. | S |
| FR-PH-005 | A Supervisor may select A only, B only, or average. The module must record the selection with a reason. It must reject a bad probe. | S, R |
| FR-PH-006 | When PV-PH is above SP-PH-01 plus SP-PH-02, FCV-510 must open in proportion to the error from the band edge. Flow must stay within SP-PH-09 to SP-PH-10. At or below the band edge, FCV-510 must be at SP-PH-09. | S, F |
| FR-PH-007 | When PV-PH is below SP-PH-01 minus SP-PH-02, P-520 must dose base. At or above the band edge, P-520 must not dose. | S, F |
| FR-PH-008 | FCV-510 and P-520 must never be active together. | S |
| FR-PH-009 | P-520 must run one pulse per SP-PH-15 cycle. Pulse time equals base output (%) times SP-PH-17. The module must skip a pulse shorter than SP-PH-16. | S, F |
| FR-PH-010 | Cumulative base volume is (reference mass minus current WT-521 mass) divided by SP-PH-14, plus the carry-forward from earlier bags. The value must never decrease during a batch. It must start at zero at SQ-01 step FR-BR500-103. | S |
| FR-PH-011 | When cumulative base volume reaches SP-PH-13, the module must raise AL-PH-06. | S |
| FR-PH-012 | On entry to AUTO, FCV-510 and P-520 outputs must start at zero. | S |
| FR-PH-013 | In MANUAL, the Operator sets acid output (%) or base output (%). Interlocks and the base lockout must stay active. | S, D |

### 4.2 DO (EM-BR500-DO)

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-DO-001 | PV-DO must equal the average of AT-502A and AT-502B when both are healthy, and the healthy probe when one is bad. A probe is bad when quality is bad or the value is outside SP-DO-10 to SP-DO-11. The module must raise AL-DO-03. | S |
| FR-DO-002 | When probes differ by more than SP-DO-12 for SP-DO-13, the module must raise AL-DO-05. Control must continue on the average. | S |
| FR-DO-003 | AIC-502 demand must rise from 0 % to 100 % as PV-DO falls below SP-DO-01. | S |
| FR-DO-004 | Stage 1: demand from 0 % to SP-DO-08 must move SIC-530 linearly from SP-DO-02 to SP-DO-03. FCV-511 and FCV-512 must be at minimum. | S, F |
| FR-DO-005 | Stage 2: demand from SP-DO-08 to SP-DO-09 must move FCV-511 linearly from SP-DO-04 to SP-DO-05. SIC-530 must stay at SP-DO-03. | S, F |
| FR-DO-006 | Stage 3: demand from SP-DO-09 to 100 % must move FCV-512 linearly from SP-DO-06 to SP-DO-07. SIC-530 and FCV-511 must stay at maximum. | S, F |
| FR-DO-007 | When demand falls, stages must reduce in reverse order: O2, then air, then agitator. | S |
| FR-DO-008 | In AUTO and MANUAL, the module must not command SIC-530 below SP-DO-02 or above SP-DO-03. | S |
| FR-DO-009 | In MANUAL, the Operator sets AIC-502 demand. The stage mapping must still apply. | S, D |
| FR-DO-010 | When demand is 100 %, FCV-512 is at SP-DO-07, and PV-DO is below SP-DO-01 minus SP-DO-14 for SP-DO-17, the module must raise AL-DO-06. | S |
| FR-DO-011 | On entry to AUTO from MANUAL, demand must start at the manual demand value. On entry to AUTO from INACTIVE, demand must start at 0 %. Outputs must not step. | S |

---

## 5. Sequences

Each step below is a requirement. Test each step by forcing its transition condition (S), forcing its timeout, and checking the failure response.

**SQ-01 Control start (Equilibrate entry, both modules)**

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-101 | Show prompt P1. | Operator confirms with signature. | SP-GEN-03 | Stay in step. Raise AL-BR500-01. |
| FR-BR500-102 | Check probe health. | At least one healthy probe in AT-501 and in AT-502. | SP-GEN-07 | Request batch Hold. Raise AL-PH-04 or AL-DO-04. |
| FR-BR500-103 | Record WT-521 reference mass. Set cumulative base volume to zero. | Value stored. | SP-GEN-01 | Lock out P-520. Raise AL-PH-08. Continue. |
| FR-BR500-104 | Start SIC-530 at SP-DO-02 if stopped. | Speed within SP-GEN-06 of SP-DO-02. | SP-GEN-07 | Request batch Hold. Raise AL-DO-07. |
| FR-BR500-105 | Set both modules to AUTO. | Both modules in AUTO. | SP-GEN-01 | Stay INACTIVE. Request batch Hold. |
| FR-BR500-106 | Report "control active" to batch. | Batch acknowledges. | SP-GEN-01 | Raise AL-BR500-01. |

**SQ-02 Base bag change (Operator-initiated, AUTO or MANUAL)**

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-201 | Stop P-520 and lock it out (FR-PH-024). | P-520 stopped. | SP-GEN-01 | Raise AL-PH-09. Do not continue. |
| FR-BR500-202 | Store cumulative base volume as carry-forward. | Value stored. | SP-GEN-01 | Keep lockout. Raise AL-PH-08. |
| FR-BR500-203 | Show prompt P2. | Operator pushes DONE. | SP-GEN-03 | Keep lockout. Raise AL-PH-08. |
| FR-BR500-204 | Check WT-521 quality and bag mass above SP-PH-18. | Good for SP-GEN-04. Store new reference mass. | SP-GEN-07 | Keep lockout. Return to step FR-BR500-203. |
| FR-BR500-205 | Show prompt P3. | Operator enters lot number and signs. | SP-GEN-03 | Keep lockout. Raise AL-PH-08. |
| FR-BR500-206 | Release lockout. Carry-forward stays in the total. | P-520 unlocked. | SP-GEN-01 | Keep lockout. Raise AL-PH-09. |

**SQ-03 Setpoint change during Production**

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-301 | Operator enters a new value. | Value inside the allowed range (SP-PH-19 to SP-PH-20, SP-DO-19 to SP-DO-20) or the limits of the parameter. | SP-GEN-02 | Reject entry. Keep old value. |
| FR-BR500-302 | Show prompt P6. | Operator enters a reason. | SP-GEN-02 | Discard entry. Keep old value. |
| FR-BR500-303 | Ask for electronic signature. | Valid signature. | SP-GEN-02 | Discard entry. Log the failed attempt. |
| FR-BR500-304 | Write record (FR-BR500-021). Apply new value. | Record written. | SP-GEN-01 | Keep old value. Raise AL-BR500-02. |

---

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

| ID | Cause | Effect | Latched or auto-reset | Reset method | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-PH-020 | Cumulative base volume at or above SP-PH-11 minus SP-PH-12 | Stop P-520. Lock out base. Raise AL-PH-07. | Latched | None during the batch. Cleared at the next batch start (OI-07). | S |
| FR-PH-021 | WT-521 bad quality or out of range | Stop P-520. Lock out base. Raise AL-PH-08. | Auto-reset | WT-521 good for SP-GEN-04 | S |
| FR-PH-022 | WT-521 bag mass at or below SP-PH-18 | Stop P-520. Lock out base. Raise AL-PH-08. | Latched | Complete SQ-02 | S |
| FR-PH-023 | SIC-530 stopped, or speed below SP-DO-02 minus SP-GEN-06 | Stop P-520. Close FCV-510. | Auto-reset | Speed at or above SP-DO-02 minus SP-GEN-06 for SP-GEN-04 | S, F |
| FR-PH-024 | SQ-02 active | Lock out P-520. | Auto-reset | SQ-02 complete | S |
| FR-DO-020 | SIC-530 stopped, faulted, or speed below SP-DO-02 minus SP-GEN-06 | Close FCV-512. Raise AL-DO-07. | Auto-reset | Same as FR-PH-023 | S, F |

Both pH probes bad and both DO probes bad are handled by the PV FAULT state (FR-BR500-006, FR-BR500-010).

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-030 | Each alarm must raise within SP-GEN-01 after its condition and delay are true. Each alarm must clear when the condition is false and the operator acknowledges it. | S (one test per row) |

## 8. Abnormal handling

Bad PV is covered by FR-PH-002, FR-PH-003, FR-DO-001 and FR-BR500-006.

| ID | Event | Response | Recovery | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-040 | Comms loss to a fieldbus device (FCV, SIC, P-520, probe transmitter, WT-521) | Probe or load cell: treat as bad. Actuator: device goes to its fail position (section 2.1). Raise the device alarm. | Device resumes the current command only in AUTO or MANUAL. | S, F |
| FR-BR500-041 | Comms loss between controller and workstation | Control continues. Outputs and timeouts do not change. | Display refreshes on recovery. | F |
| FR-BR500-042 | Controller failover (if redundant) | State, outputs, reference mass and base total must not change. | None needed. | F |
| FR-BR500-043 | Power loss to controller, then restart | The module saves state, reference mass, carry-forward and base total in non-volatile memory. It restarts in HELD (FR-BR500-004). No output energizes by itself. | Operator shows prompt P4 and pushes RESUME (FR-BR500-005). | F |
| FR-BR500-044 | Power loss to field devices | FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512 close. P-520 stops. SIC-530 stops (section 2.1). | Devices stay at fail position until the module leaves HELD. | F |
| FR-BR500-045 | Loss of CO2, air or O2 supply | Raise AL-PH-09 or AL-DO-08. Control logic does not change. | Operator restores the supply. | F |
